static_traits.name: Lin Hao然
static_traits.medical_history: without重要躯体疾病史；此前not yet有类似问题，not yet接受过心理咨询/治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，略显保留，倾向聚焦错误与Self-doubt，配合度尚可

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得我的舞蹈能力not重要，因为任何有两只脚的人都能做到，这导致我感到被negate并低估自己的能力。
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，因为这种被negate的感觉开始影响我对舞蹈的享受和我的自尊。
growth_experiences: 几年前开始频繁收到对舞蹈的称赞，同时经历搬到新城市（新学校、新朋友、环境骤变）的压力；在此过程中逐渐产生对称赞的not信任与被negate感，认为“任何人都能跳舞”，在被表扬时Self-doubt worsens并not断Reinforcement。

core_beliefs: 我的优点和成就not算数/not值得被认可
I am not good enough，称赞not真实

special_situations.event: After the dance showcase ended, someone praised her performance to her face as 'great / wonderful'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果表演中有任何失误或not完美，就not配得到称赞，称赞一定not真实
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Accepts with a surface smile, devalues the positive feedback inside, avoids acknowledging her own strengths
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just being polite, I am actually deceiving them.

special_situations.event: 平时do not人夸赞其舞蹈能力时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人夸奖，往往只是出于礼貌或社交需要，not可信
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 猜测他人动机、negate正向信息，避免产生正面自我评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是说好听的，并not是真的这么想。

special_situations.event: Reviewing one's performance after a show, noticing several mistakes made
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 有错误就意味着整体表现很Average甚至失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 只关注错误与not足，忽略完成好的部分
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我表现得很尴尬，失误说明我not行。

special_situations.event: After moving to a new city, faces a new school, new friends, and a new environment
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 在新环境里如果我感到格格not入，说明我的舞蹈并not特do not，也not会被真正认可
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lowers self-evaluation, is skeptical of praise, reduces motivation to dance to avoid disappointment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 在这里我的舞蹈not算什么，大家都能做到。

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被真实地看见与肯定，作为Dancer被欣赏
core_conflict.fear: 害怕称赞not真实、被揭穿为“并not够好”的羞耻与negate
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of being exposed and shamed by devaluing positive feedback and focusing on errors
Maintains a psychologically safe distance, avoiding the disappointment brought by attachment and expectations

object_relations.self_representation: A flawed performer who may be an 'impostor'
object_relations.object_representation: 表面友善但not可靠、出于礼貌随口称赞的评判者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others invite him to acknowledge strengths and review what was done well
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing that admitting strengths equals self-deception, and being seen through would bring more shame
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气克制、强调事实与错误细节，弱化情感表达，用“客观分析”来negate积极面。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When receiving direct praise or positive feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interprets others' kindness as polite, false praise
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以平淡语气表示“大家都会/这not算什么”，用社会礼仪或普遍性解释来淡化称赞。

manifestations: 认为“任何人有两只脚都能跳舞”，由此negate自身skill的独特性与价值
When praised, feels like a 'fraud', finds it hard to experience the meaning of being seen and affirmed
搬家后对自我定位与价值产生动摇，觉得舞蹈“not算什么”
outcomes: 舞蹈Decreased motivation、日常作息受影响
回避接受正面反馈，体验被negate与not真实

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 将自己的not接纳归因为“对方只是礼貌/客套”，negate称赞的真实性
在被表扬时假定他人动机not真诚

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 过度关注错误与not足，害怕被认为“钓赞”，not愿向朋友表达not安
When reviewing performance, mainly emphasizes mistakes and suppresses self-affirmation

positive_force: 舞蹈skill得到他人多次正向反馈
Can notice and express one's own troubles; willing to seek help
Has several friends to confide in (though temporarily finds it hard to speak up)
negative_force: negate正向信息的认知风格（Disqualifying the Positive）
Mind-reading-style inference of others' motives, focusing only on mistakes (Mental Filtering)
搬家与新环境带来的not适与not安全感
Self-doubt在受表扬情境下加重，影响动机与日常

target_behavior.behavior: 在被称赞舞蹈时自动negate积极反馈，产生“像骗子”的感受并减少练习/表演意愿
antecedent: Others' praise or positive feedback on their dancing
演出结束后的自我回顾
Facing new environments and new peers after moving to a new city
target_behavior.core_reason: 搬迁与适应压力下Shaken sense of self-worth，形成“negate正面”的认知偏差与对羞耻/被揭穿的担忧
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的羞耻与被揭穿风险，维持“我并not特do not”的自我一致感
target_behavior.consequence: Lowered self-esteem、舞蹈Decreased motivation并影响日常作息
